caption: The drawing consists of a stylized floral composition centered on a large, branching stem rendered in dark blue. The stem has multiple offshoots, each bearing a variety of flowers and leaves. Two large, round, red flowers with layered petals and yellow centers are prominent near the top and middle of the central stem, surrounded by green leaves with distinct veining. Other blooms on the branches are colored blue, pink, and yellow, with some resembling tulips or having fringed petals. The leaves vary in shades of green and blue, some elongated and some more rounded, and are distributed evenly along the branches. Small accent flowers in red and pink are interspersed throughout. A small butterfly with blue wings and yellow accents is near the left edge of the stem, and near the bottom right corner, there is a small brown bird facing left. The background is a plain, beige-colored surface, possibly fabric or paper, bordered by a simple frame with some brownish mottled spots.
title: Bed Canopy Detail
